cohort: Participants were individuals who received the 4CMenB vaccine in the Apulia region of Italy between January 1, 2014, and December 31, 2019, from whom adverse event following immunization (AEFI) data were collected through the National Pharmacovigilance Network.
finding: The study confirmed a good safety profile of universal mass vaccination with 4CMenB in a large population, with reported AEFIs (26.5 per 100,000 doses) and serious AEFIs (7.2 per 100,000 doses) being consistent with previous findings.
